### What is the average temperature in August
The average temperature in Mumbai in August for a typical day ranges from a high of 83°F (28°C) to a low of 78°F (26°C).Some would describe the temperature to be very warm. The general area may also feel slightly windy.

### How windy is it in August
Historically, the wind in Mumbai during August blows at an average speed of 16.4 mph (26.4 kph). The windiest month is July with an average wind speed of 18.2 mph (29.2 kph), while the calmest month is October with an average wind speed of 9.1 mph (14.7 kph).

### Where does this data come from
For all data based on historical data, we've averaged the data from the past 11 years (2010-2020). For example, for the hourly temperature at 10am, we've looked at the temperature at 10am on every day in August (e.g., August 1, August 2, etc. in 2010, 2011, etc.) and took the arithmetic mean.
We did not smooth the data, so for example, our daily temperature line will have some randomness due to the fact that weather is random in the first place.
